name: Habitica
description: Gamified habit and task tracker that turns daily to-dos into a role playing game.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      NODE_DB_URI: "mongodb://{{serviceName}}-mongo:27017/habitica"
      BASE_URL: "http://localhost:8132"
      SESSION_SECRET: {{env.SESSION_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/habitica/config
  {{serviceName}}-mongo:
    image: mongo:6
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
